verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the headline, URL and 'HO SMART' wordmark have vanished (white text left on white). The logo icon floats as a faint grey outline, the blue panel is a cropped wedge, and the bottom ~60% of the canvas is empty. B keeps the whole design intact and readable but just shrinks the banner into a thin strip in the middle of a blank portrait canvas, so the text is small, about 85% of the space is dead and nothing was rearranged for the tall format. It is still clearly broken, just less so than A.
